post.description: Tool to retrieve company overview and fundamental data for individual company stocks. Note: This endpoint only works for stocks, not ETFs, mutual funds, or indices. Use after specifying a valid stock ticker symbol. Numeric fields (e.g., MarketCapitalization, SharesOutstanding, Beta, DividendYield, PERatio) are returned as strings and may be empty — treat empty/missing values as null, not zero. Fundamentals such as Beta, PERatio, and PayoutRatio may reflect different reporting periods across symbols; avoid naive cross-symbol aggregation without aligning periods. Check the as-of date in the response; SharesOutstanding and similar fields can lag corporate actions. Alpha Vantage enforces per-minute and per-day rate caps; throttle requests when processing bulk symbol lists.

apikey.description: Override API key. If provided, this key is used instead of metadata's apikey.

symbol.description: Ticker symbol for an individual company stock (e.g., 'IBM'). Note: This endpoint only works for stocks, not ETFs, mutual funds, or indices. Small-cap and non-US listings may return partial or incomplete data; validate coverage before computing metrics.

max_range.description: Maximum range in nautical miles. Filter aircraft with range less than or equal to this value.

max_speed.description: Maximum speed in knots. Filter aircraft with speed less than or equal to this value.

min_range.description: Minimum range in nautical miles. Filter aircraft with range greater than or equal to this value.

min_speed.description: Minimum speed in knots. Filter aircraft with speed greater than or equal to this value.

post.description: Tool to search for airport information by IATA code, ICAO code, name, city, country, or region. Use when you need to find airport details, coordinates, or codes. Returns up to 10 matching airports.

city.description: City name to search for airports (e.g., 'New York', 'London', 'Paris'). Returns all airports in the specified city.

iata.description: 3-letter IATA airport code (e.g., 'JFK', 'LHR', 'CDG'). Use this to search for a specific airport by its international code.

icao.description: 4-letter ICAO airport code (e.g., 'KJFK', 'EGLL', 'LFPG'). Use this to search for a specific airport by its ICAO designation.

name.description: Airport name to search for (e.g., 'John F Kennedy International Airport', 'Heathrow'). Partial matches are supported.

offset.description: Number of results to offset for pagination. Use this to paginate through results by setting offset to multiples of the result limit (e.g., 0, 30, 60).

region.description: Region or state to search for airports (e.g., 'California', 'Texas', 'England'). Returns all airports in the specified region.

country.description: Country code or name to search for airports (e.g., 'US', 'United States', 'GB', 'United Kingdom'). Returns all airports in the specified country.

post.description: Tool to retrieve air quality index and pollutant data for a location. Use when you need current air quality information for environmental monitoring or health assessments. Query by city name or GPS coordinates.

lat.description: Latitude coordinate (-90 to 90). Must be used together with lon parameter.

lon.description: Longitude coordinate (-180 to 180). Must be used together with lat parameter.

city.description: City name. Must provide either city or coordinates (lat/lon).

state.description: US state name or abbreviation (for US cities only). Use with city parameter to disambiguate locations.

country.description: Country name or ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code. Use with city parameter to disambiguate locations.

post.description: Tool to retrieve detailed scientific information about animal species. Use to look up taxonomy, habitat, diet, or physical characteristics for an animal species.

name.description: Common name of the animal to search for. Returns up to 10 matching results.

post.description: Tool to get baby name suggestions by gender. Returns 10 baby name suggestions that can be filtered by gender (boy, girl, or neutral) and popularity. Use when you need baby name ideas or recommendations.

popular_only.description: Whether to only return popular names (top 10% of names). Set to true to get only popular names, false to include less common names. Defaults to true.

post.description: Tool to retrieve a random bucket list idea or activity. Use when you need inspiration for bucket list items or life goals.

Tool to retrieve information on cat breeds matching specified parameters. Use when you need to search for cat breeds by characteristics such as name, weight, life expectancy, shedding level, playfulness, grooming needs, or friendliness with family and other pets.

name.description: Cat breed name to search for (e.g., 'persian', 'siamese'). Partial matches are supported.

offset.description: Number of results to offset for pagination. Use this to paginate through results by setting offset to multiples of the result limit (e.g., 0, 20, 40).

grooming.description: Grooming needs on a scale of 1-5, where 1 requires maximum grooming effort and 5 requires minimum grooming effort.

shedding.description: Shedding level on a scale of 1-5, where 1 is minimal shedding and 5 is heavy shedding.

max_weight.description: Maximum weight in pounds. Must be greater than min_weight if both are specified.

min_weight.description: Minimum weight in pounds. Must be less than max_weight if both are specified.

playfulness.description: Playfulness level on a scale of 1-5, where 1 is less playful and 5 is very playful.

family_friendly.description: Family friendliness level on a scale of 1-5, where 1 is less family-friendly and 5 is very family-friendly.

max_life_expectancy.description: Maximum life expectancy in years. Must be greater than min_life_expectancy if both are specified.

min_life_expectancy.description: Minimum life expectancy in years. Must be less than max_life_expectancy if both are specified.

other_pets_friendly.description: Pet friendliness level on a scale of 1-5, where 1 is less friendly with other pets and 5 is very friendly with other pets.

post.description: Tool to search for celebrity information by name or other criteria. Returns details including net worth, height, birthday, nationality, and occupation. Use when you need to find information about famous people, filter celebrities by attributes like net worth or nationality, or gather biographical data.

name.description: Name of the celebrity you wish to search. This field is case-insensitive.

offset.description: Number of results to offset for pagination.

max_height.description: Maximum height of celebrities in meters.

min_height.description: Minimum height of celebrities in meters.

nationality.description: Nationality of celebrities. Must be an ISO 3166 Alpha-2 country code (e.g., US, GB, FR).

max_net_worth.description: Maximum net worth of celebrities in US dollars.

min_net_worth.description: Minimum net worth of celebrities in US dollars.

post.description: Tool to retrieve a random Chuck Norris joke from the API Ninjas database. Use when you need humorous Chuck Norris content.

Tool to retrieve city information by name, country, coordinates, or population filters. Use when you need geographic data about cities including coordinates, population, and capital status. At least one search parameter is required.

name.description: City name to search for (e.g., 'London', 'New York').

limit.description: Number of results to return per request (range: 1-30). Premium feature only.

offset.description: Pagination offset to skip the first N results.

country.description: ISO-3166 alpha-2 country code to filter cities (e.g., 'US', 'GB', 'JP').

max_lat.description: Maximum latitude coordinate for geographic filtering (range: -90 to 90).

max_lon.description: Maximum longitude coordinate for geographic filtering (range: -180 to 180).

min_lat.description: Minimum latitude coordinate for geographic filtering (range: -90 to 90).

min_lon.description: Minimum longitude coordinate for geographic filtering (range: -180 to 180).

max_population.description: Maximum population count for filtering cities.

min_population.description: Minimum population count for filtering cities.

post.description: Tool to search for cocktail recipes by name or ingredients. Returns up to 10 cocktail recipes with ingredients and preparation instructions. Use when you need cocktail recipes, drink mixing instructions, or want to find drinks by specific ingredients.

name.description: Cocktail name to search for. At least one of name or ingredients is required. Supports partial matches (e.g., 'marg' matches 'Margarita'). Case-insensitive.

ingredients.description: Comma-separated ingredients to search for. At least one of name or ingredients is required. Uses AND logic and is case-insensitive.

post.description: Tool to retrieve company logo images by company name or ticker symbol. Use when you need to display or download company logos.

name.description: Company name that supports partial matching (case-insensitive). Either name or ticker is required.

ticker.description: Company ticker symbol for publicly traded companies. Either name or ticker is required.

post.description: Tool to retrieve country flag images in SVG format. Use when you need flag URLs for display or download.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g., US, CA, GB). UK regional codes GB-ENG, GB-SCT, GB-WLS and GB-NIR are also supported. Country names are not supported.

post.description: Tool to retrieve country information by name, ISO code, or economic and demographic filters. Use to retrieve country population, GDP, surface area, unemployment, fertility, and related statistics.

name.description: Plain English name, 2-letter ISO-3166 alpha-2 (e.g., 'US'), or 3-letter ISO-3166 alpha-3 (e.g., 'USA') code of country.

limit.description: How many results to return. Must be between 1 and 30. Default is 5.

max_gdp.description: Maximum gross domestic product (GDP) of country, in US Dollars.

min_gdp.description: Minimum gross domestic product (GDP) of country, in US Dollars.

max_fertility.description: Maximum fertility rate, in average children per woman.

min_fertility.description: Minimum fertility rate, in average children per woman.

max_population.description: Maximum population of country, in thousands.

min_population.description: Minimum population of country, in thousands.

max_surface_area.description: Maximum surface area of country in km2.

min_surface_area.description: Minimum surface area of country in km2.

max_infant_mortality.description: Maximum infant mortality rate per 1,000 live births.

min_infant_mortality.description: Minimum infant mortality rate per 1,000 live births.

post.description: Tool to retrieve US county information by name, ZIP code, or state. Use when you need geographic, demographic, or administrative data about US counties. Returns county name, FIPS code, location coordinates, timezone, population, and median age.

limit.description: Number of results to return. Must be between 1 and 30. Default is 1. Premium only.

state.description: 2-letter state code (e.g., 'CA', 'OR', 'NY'). At least one of county, zipcode, or state must be provided.

county.description: Full county name (e.g., 'Los Angeles County', 'Multnomah County'). At least one of county, zipcode, or state must be provided.

offset.description: Number of results to offset for pagination. Default is 0. Premium only.

zipcode.description: 5-digit ZIP code to search for county information. At least one of county, zipcode, or state must be provided.

post.description: Tool to retrieve random dad jokes from API Ninjas. Returns one or more dad jokes suitable for light humor. Use when you need clean, family-friendly jokes.

limit.description: How many jokes to return. Must be between 1 and 100. Default is 1. Note: Values greater than 1 require a premium API Ninjas subscription.

post.description: Tool to get historical events for a specific date. Use when you need to retrieve events that occurred on a particular day in history. Returns events for today's date if no parameters are provided.

day.description: The day of the month for the historical events to retrieve. Must be between 1 and 31. If specified, month must also be provided. Premium subscription required to specify custom dates.

limit.description: The maximum number of results to return. Must be between 1 and 30. Default is 1.

month.description: The month of the historical events to retrieve. Must be between 1 and 12. If specified, day must also be provided. Premium subscription required to specify custom dates.

offset.description: The number of results to skip. Must be zero or a positive integer. Used for pagination. Default is 0.

post.description: Tool to retrieve dictionary definition for an English word. Use when you need the meaning or definition of a word.

word.description: Word to look up in the dictionary. Must be a valid English word.

post.description: Tool to get information on dog breeds matching specified parameters. Use when you need breed characteristics like temperament, size, life expectancy, or other traits.

name.description: Dog breed name to search for (e.g., 'husky', 'labrador').

energy.description: Energy level (1-5, where 1 is lowest and 5 is highest).

offset.description: Number of results to offset for pagination. Use this to paginate through results by setting offset to multiples of the result limit (e.g., 0, 20, 40).

barking.description: Barking level (1-5, where 1 is lowest and 5 is highest).

shedding.description: Shedding level (1-5, where 1 is lowest and 5 is highest).

trainability.description: Trainability level (1-5, where 1 is lowest and 5 is highest).

protectiveness.description: Protectiveness level (1-5, where 1 is lowest and 5 is highest).

post.description: Retrieve earnings filings by company, fiscal period, or filing date.

cik.description: Company Central Index Key. Mutually exclusive with ticker. Supply a company identifier, date, or complete date range.

date.description: Exact filing date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Mutually exclusive with date_start/date_end; supply a company identifier, date, or complete date range.

year.description: Fiscal year. Required with period or quarter, which also require a company identifier. Free users are limited to 2026; Premium covers the last 5 fiscal years; Business tier and above provides full history.

offset.description: Results to skip; pages contain 50.

period.description: Fiscal period. Mutually exclusive with quarter and requires a company identifier and year.

ticker.description: Company ticker symbol. Mutually exclusive with cik. Supply a company identifier, date, or complete date range.

quarter.description: Fiscal quarter. Mutually exclusive with period and requires a company identifier and year.

date_end.description: Range end in YYYY-MM-DD format. Requires date_start and is mutually exclusive with date; supply a company identifier, date, or complete date range.

date_start.description: Range start in YYYY-MM-DD format. Requires date_end and is mutually exclusive with date; supply a company identifier, date, or complete date range.

post.description: Get electric vehicle information by make, model, year range, or electric range. Returns details including battery capacity, charging power, dimensions, and performance specs. At least one filter parameter (make, model, min_year, max_year, min_range, or max_range) is required - limit and offset alone are not sufficient.

limit.description: How many results to return. Must be between 1 and 10. Default is 1.

offset.description: Number of results to skip for pagination. Default is 0.

max_year.description: Maximum vehicle model year (e.g., 2023). Filter results to vehicles up to this year.

min_year.description: Minimum vehicle model year (e.g., 2020). Filter results to vehicles from this year onwards.

max_range.description: Maximum electric range in kilometers (e.g., 600). Filter results to vehicles with at most this range.

min_range.description: Minimum electric range in kilometers (e.g., 250). Filter results to vehicles with at least this range.

post.description: Tool to retrieve emoji information and images from the API Ninjas Emoji database. Use when you need emoji metadata, Unicode codes, or emoji images based on name, code, category, or subcategory. At least one search parameter (name, code, group, or subgroup) must be provided. Returns up to 30 results per request; use offset for pagination.

code.description: Unicode character code for the emoji (e.g., 'U+1F642'). Must be uppercase with U+ prefix.

name.description: Descriptive name of emoji to search for (e.g., 'smile', 'heart').

group.description: Main category to filter emojis. Valid categories: smileys_emotion, people_body, component, animals_nature, food_drink, travel_places, activities, objects, symbols, flags.

offset.description: Number of results to offset for pagination. Use this to retrieve results beyond the first 30. Default is 0.

subgroup.description: Sub-category to filter emojis within a group. The subgroup must be valid for the selected group.

post.description: Get the current exchange rate for a currency pair. Returns the conversion rate from the first currency to the second currency. Use this to check current foreign exchange rates between any two currencies.

pair.description: Currency pair in format CURRENCY1_CURRENCY2 (e.g., 'GBP_AUD', 'USD_EUR', 'JPY_USD'). Use underscore to separate the two currency codes.

post.description: Tool to get exercise information by muscle group, type, or difficulty level. Returns up to 10 exercises that match the specified criteria. Use when you need to find exercises for specific muscle groups, workout types, or difficulty levels.

name.description: Name of the exercise to search for. Searches for exercises matching this name.

muscle.description: Target muscle group to filter by. Common values include: abdominals, abductors, adductors, biceps, calves, chest, forearms, glutes, hamstrings, lats, lower_back, middle_back, neck, quadriceps, traps, triceps.

offset.description: Number of results to offset for pagination. Use this to paginate through results by setting offset to multiples of the result limit (e.g., 0, 10, 20).

post.description: Tool to retrieve random interesting facts from API Ninjas. Returns facts about science, literature, philosophy, and other topics. Use when you need interesting factual information to display or share.

limit.description: Number of facts to return. Must be between 1 and 100. Default is 1. Note: Requesting more than 1 fact requires a premium API Ninjas subscription.

post.description: Tool to retrieve the fact of the day from API Ninjas. Returns the same fact for all users on a given day, with facts changing daily. Use when you need a daily interesting fact to display or share.
Tool to get GDP data for a country. Use when you need GDP statistics including growth rate, nominal GDP, GDP per capita, and purchasing power parity data.

year.description: Year for which to retrieve GDP data. At least one of country or year must be set.

country.description: Country name (case-insensitive) or 2-letter ISO-3166 alpha-2 code (e.g., 'Canada' or 'CA'). At least one of country or year must be set.

post.description: Tool to convert city names to geographic coordinates (forward geocoding). Returns latitude, longitude, and country code for specified city. Use when you need to find the coordinates of a location by its name.

city.description: City name to geocode. Required parameter for converting a city location to latitude and longitude coordinates.

state.description: Optional US state name or abbreviation to narrow down the search. Only applicable for cities in the United States (e.g., 'California' or 'CA').

country.description: Optional 2-letter ISO 3166 alpha-2 country code to narrow down the search (e.g., 'GB' for United Kingdom, 'US' for United States). Useful when multiple cities share the same name.

post.description: Tool to get helicopter information by manufacturer, model, and specifications. Use when you need detailed technical specifications for helicopters including speed, range, dimensions, and load capacity. At least one search parameter (manufacturer, model, or specification filter) must be provided.

limit.description: Number of results to return. Must be between 1 and 30. Defaults to 1 if not specified.

max_speed.description: Maximum air speed ceiling in knots.

min_speed.description: Minimum maximum air speed in knots.

manufacturer.description: Company that designed and built the helicopter (e.g., 'Bell', 'Airbus', 'Sikorsky').

post.description: Tool to retrieve historical events by date or keywords. Use when you need information about events that happened on a specific date or related to specific topics.

day.description: Calendar day of the month to filter events (1-31).

text.description: Keywords or short phrases to search events. Useful for finding events related to specific topics or people.

year.description: 4-digit year to filter events. Use negative values for BC/BCE dates (e.g., -351 for 351 BC).

month.description: Month number to filter events (1-12, e.g., 3 for March).

offset.description: Number of results to offset for pagination. Premium feature only.

post.description: Tool to search for historical figures by name. Returns biographical information including birth/death dates, titles, awards, offices held, and family details. Use when you need information about famous people from history.

name.description: Name of the person to search. Supports partial matching (e.g., 'julius' will match Julius Caesar). Case-insensitive.

offset.description: Number of results to offset for pagination.

post.description: Tool to get random hobby suggestions from API Ninjas. Use when you need inspiration for new hobbies or activities, optionally filtered by category.

Tool to get daily horoscope for a zodiac sign. Returns the horoscope text for the specified zodiac sign and date. Use when you need astrological predictions or daily horoscope information for any of the 12 zodiac signs.

date.description: Historical horoscope retrieval in YYYY-MM-DD format (premium feature). Must be current date or earlier. Defaults to today's date if omitted.

zodiac.description: The astrological sign to retrieve horoscope data for. Must be one of the 12 zodiac signs.

post.description: Find hospitals by name, city, state, ZIP code or county. Provide at least one of these filters; coordinate-only searches are not supported. Optional geographic bounds filter the requested provider page. Longitude bounds are applied locally; limit and offset select provider rows before local filtering, so results may be fewer than limit. Advance offset to inspect further pages, even after an empty filtered page.

city.description: City where the hospital is located (e.g., 'New York', 'Los Angeles').

name.description: Hospital name to search for (e.g., 'General Hospital', 'Memorial'). Partial matches are supported.

limit.description: Number of results to return per request (maximum 100, free users limited to 5).

state.description: State where the hospital is located (e.g., 'NY', 'CA', 'Texas').

county.description: County where the hospital is located (e.g., 'New York County', 'Los Angeles County').

offset.description: Provider-row offset to skip the first N results. Geographic bounds are enforced within each provider page; advance offset to inspect further pages.

max_latitude.description: Maximum latitude coordinate for geographic filtering (range: -90 to 90).

min_latitude.description: Minimum latitude coordinate for geographic filtering (range: -90 to 90).

max_longitude.description: Maximum longitude coordinate, applied locally within the requested provider page (range: -180 to 180). Requires a name or location filter; coordinate-only search is not supported.

min_longitude.description: Minimum longitude coordinate, applied locally within the requested provider page (range: -180 to 180). Requires a name or location filter; coordinate-only search is not supported.

post.description: Get federal and regional income-tax rates for a country and year.

country.description: Two-letter country code, such as US or CA.

regions.description: Comma-separated region codes or 'federal'; omit for all regions.

federal_only.description: Legacy filter. True maps to regions='federal'; false or null leaves regions unfiltered.

post.description: Tool to get insider trading transactions for publicly traded companies. Returns SEC-filed insider trading data including purchases, sales, and awards by company executives, directors, and major shareholders. Use when you need to track insider activity, analyze insider sentiment, or research specific transactions by ticker, insider name, or transaction details.

cik.description: Central Index Key (CIK) of the company. Alternative to ticker for identifying companies (e.g., '789019').

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Use to limit response size.

ticker.description: Company ticker symbol (e.g., 'AAPL', 'MSFT'). Use to filter transactions by company stock symbol.

form_type.description: SEC form types for insider trading

insider_name.description: Exact name of the insider; partial matching is not supported. Use to find transactions by a specific insider.

transaction_date.description: Exact transaction date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Use to find transactions on a specific date.

transaction_type.description: Type of transaction (e.g., 'Purchase', 'Sale', 'Award'). Use to filter by transaction category.

max_transaction_date.description: Maximum transaction date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Use with min_transaction_date to define a date range.

min_transaction_date.description: Minimum transaction date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Use with max_transaction_date to define a date range.

max_transaction_value.description: Maximum transaction value in USD. Use with min_transaction_value to define a value range.

min_transaction_value.description: Minimum transaction value in USD. Use to filter significant transactions (e.g., 1000000 for transactions over $1M).

post.description: Tool to retrieve random jokes from API Ninjas. Returns one or more jokes suitable for entertainment. Use when you need general humor content.

limit.description: How many jokes to return. Must be between 1 and 30. Default is 1.

post.description: Tool to retrieve the joke of the day from API Ninjas. Returns the same joke for all users on a given day, with jokes changing daily. Use when you need a daily joke to display or share.

Tool to get detailed motorcycle specifications by make, model, and year. Use when you need technical data about specific motorcycle models including engine specs, dimensions, transmission, suspension, and performance data.

make.description: Name of manufacturer/brand. Supports partial matching (e.g., 'Harley' matches 'Harley-Davidson'). Either make or model must be provided.

model.description: Name of motorcycle model. Supports partial matching (e.g., 'Ninja' matches 'Ninja 650'). Either make or model must be provided.

offset.description: Number of results to offset for pagination. Default is 0. Premium feature only.

post.description: Tool to get mutual fund information by ticker. Returns the fund's name, ISIN, CUSIP, and country. Note: price, expense_ratio, aum, num_holdings, and holdings require a premium API subscription and will return null for free-tier users.

isin.description: International Securities Identification Number of the fund share class. Supply exactly one of ticker or isin.

ticker.description: Mutual Fund ticker symbol. Case-insensitive. Supply exactly one of ticker or isin.

post.description: Tool to retrieve MX (Mail Exchange) records for a specified domain. Use when you need to identify mail servers responsible for accepting email for a domain.

domain.description: A valid domain name to query MX records for (e.g., example.com).

post.description: Tool to retrieve detailed information about planets and exoplanets including mass, radius, orbital period, temperature, and host star data. Use when you need astronomical data about planets in the known universe. At least one parameter (other than offset) must be set.

name.description: The name of the planet to search for.

offset.description: Offset results for pagination. Returns at most 30 results per request.

max_mass.description: Maximum mass of the planet in Jupiters (1 Jupiter = 1.898 × 10²⁷ kg).

min_mass.description: Minimum mass of the planet in Jupiters (1 Jupiter = 1.898 × 10²⁷ kg).

max_period.description: Maximum orbital period of the planet in Earth days.

max_radius.description: Maximum average radius of the planet in Jupiters (1 Jupiter = 69911 km).

min_period.description: Minimum orbital period of the planet in Earth days.

min_radius.description: Minimum average radius of the planet in Jupiters (1 Jupiter = 69911 km).

max_temperature.description: Maximum average surface temperature in Kelvin.

min_temperature.description: Minimum average surface temperature in Kelvin.

max_distance_light_year.description: Maximum distance from Earth in light years.

min_distance_light_year.description: Minimum distance from Earth in light years.

post.description: Tool to get population data for a country. Use when you need historical and forecasted population statistics including yearly changes, migration, demographics, and urban population metrics.

offset.description: Offset results for pagination.

country.description: Country name (case-insensitive) or 2-letter ISO-3166 alpha-2 code (e.g., 'Japan' or 'JP'). At least one of country, min_population, or max_population must be set.

max_population.description: Maximum population of country. At least one of country, min_population, or max_population must be set.

min_population.description: Minimum population of country. At least one of country, min_population, or max_population must be set.

post.description: Tool to retrieve location information for Canadian postal codes. Returns city, province, coordinates, area code, and timezone data. Use when you need to find location details for a postal code or search by city/province.

city.description: Full city name (case-sensitive) to search for location information. Premium tier required. At least one of postal_code, city, or province must be provided.

province.description: 2-letter Canadian province abbreviation (e.g., 'ON' for Ontario, 'BC' for British Columbia). Premium tier required. At least one of postal_code, city, or province must be provided.

postal_code.description: Canadian postal code (6 or 7 characters with optional space, e.g., 'K1A0B1' or 'K1A 0B1'). At least one of postal_code, city, or province must be provided.

post.description: Tool to get property tax rates by city, county, or ZIP code. Use when you need effective property tax rate statistics for a specific location.

zip.description: The ZIP Code to look up. At least one of city, county, or zip must be specified.

city.description: Full name of the city (case-sensitive). At least one of city, county, or zip must be specified.

county.description: Name of the county requesting property tax data. At least one of city, county, or zip must be specified.

post.description: Tool to retrieve official public holidays for a specific country and year. Use when you need information about federal and regional public holidays for planning, scheduling, or calendar-related tasks. Supports calendar years from 1980 to 2050.

year.description: Calendar year to retrieve public holidays for. Must be between 1980 and 2050 (inclusive). Defaults to current year if not specified.

country.description: 2-letter ISO country code or full country name (e.g., 'US', 'United States', 'GB', 'United Kingdom'). Determines which country's public holidays to retrieve.

post.description: Tool to retrieve the quote of the day from API Ninjas. Returns the same quote for all users on a given day, with quotes changing daily. Use when you need an inspirational or thought-provoking daily quote to display or share.
Tool to get a random image by category from API Ninjas. Use when you need random image content for display or download.

category.description: Image category filter (e.g., wildlife, nature, city). Premium subscription required for category filtering.

post.description: Tool to retrieve random quotes from API Ninjas. Filter by categories, author, or work title. Use when you need inspirational quotes, wisdom, or literary references for content or motivation.

work.description: Filter by work/book title using partial string matching. Matches quotes from works whose titles contain this string.

limit.description: Number of random results returned (1-100 range). Default is 1. Note: This is a premium-only feature and will return an error for non-premium accounts.

author.description: Filter by author name using partial string matching. Matches quotes from authors whose names contain this string.

categories.description: Comma-separated list of category names to include. Results match all specified categories. Available categories: wisdom, philosophy, life, truth, inspirational, relationships, love, faith, humor, success, courage, happiness, art, writing, fear, nature, time, freedom, death, leadership.

exclude_categories.description: Comma-separated list of categories to exclude. Results won't match any listed categories.

post.description: Tool to get a random English word from the API Ninjas Random Word endpoint. Use when you need random words for games, education, or creative projects. Optionally filter by word type (noun, verb, adjective, adverb).

type.description: Filter by word type. Options: noun, verb, adjective, adverb. Leave empty for any type.

post.description: Tool to convert geographic coordinates to location information (reverse geocoding). Returns location name, country code, and state/region for specified coordinates. Use when you need to find address or place information from latitude and longitude.

lat.description: Latitude coordinate in decimal degrees (range: -90 to 90). Required for reverse geocoding.

lon.description: Longitude coordinate in decimal degrees (range: -180 to 180). Required for reverse geocoding.

post.description: Tool to get words that rhyme with a given word. Use when you need to find rhyming words for creative writing, poetry, or songwriting.

word.description: The word to find rhymes for. Must be a valid English word.

post.description: Tool to retrieve random riddles with answers from API Ninjas. Returns one or more riddles suitable for entertainment and brain teasers. Use when you need riddles for games, quizzes, or entertainment purposes.

limit.description: Number of riddles to return. Must be between 1 and 20. Default is 1. Note: Requesting more than 1 riddle is a Premium only feature.

post.description: Tool to get sales tax rates by ZIP code or city and state. Use when you need current sales tax rate information for a specific US location. Either provide zip_code alone OR city+state together.

d.description: End month in Yahoo Finance format (0-11, where 0=January, 11=December). For example, use '00' for January, '05' for June, '11' for December.

e.description: End day of month (01-31). Use two-digit format with leading zero if needed (e.g., '01', '05', '15', '31').

g.description: Data period/frequency. 'd' for daily (default), 'w' for weekly, 'm' for monthly. Weekly data shows data for Fridays; monthly data shows end-of-month values.

s.description: Stock symbol with exchange suffix in format 'TICKER.EXCHANGE' (e.g., 'MCD.US' for McDonald's on US exchanges, 'AAPL.US' for Apple, 'BP.LSE' for BP on London Stock Exchange).

fmt.description: Output format for the response. Note: The Yahoo Finance style endpoint only supports CSV format internally. This parameter is kept for API compatibility but is not sent to the server. The action will always parse CSV and return JSON.

post.description: Tool to convert between different security identifiers (CUSIP, ISIN, FIGI, LEI, CIK, ticker symbol). Use when you need to map one type of identifier to another, normalize portfolio data, or cross-reference securities across different systems. At least one filter parameter must be provided.

fmt.description: Output format. Use 'json' for JSON response.

filter_ex.description: Filter by exchange code (e.g., 'US', 'LSE', 'XETRA'). Use this to get all symbols from a specific exchange.

filter_cik.description: Filter by CIK (Central Index Key) identifier used by the SEC. Use this to find securities associated with a specific SEC filer.

filter_lei.description: Filter by LEI (Legal Entity Identifier). Use this to find securities associated with a specific legal entity.

page_limit.description: Maximum number of results to return per page. Default is 1000.

filter_figi.description: Filter by FIGI (Financial Instrument Global Identifier). Use this to find the ticker symbol and other identifiers for a given FIGI.

filter_isin.description: Filter by ISIN (International Securities Identification Number) identifier. Use this to find the ticker symbol and other identifiers for a given ISIN.

page_offset.description: Number of results to skip for pagination. Use this to retrieve subsequent pages of results.

filter_cusip.description: Filter by CUSIP (Committee on Uniform Securities Identification Procedures) identifier. Use this to find the ticker symbol and other identifiers for a given CUSIP.

filter_symbol.description: Filter by ticker symbol in 'TICKER.EXCHANGE' format (e.g., 'AAPL.US'). Use this to find other identifiers for a given ticker symbol.

post.description: Retrieve macroeconomic indicator data for a specific country from EODHD. Returns historical time series data for economic indicators like GDP, inflation, unemployment, population, and many more. Data typically spans from 1960 to the present year. Use this when you need economic statistics for analysis, comparison, or research.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code (3 letters) for which to retrieve indicators. Examples: 'USA' (United States), 'GBR' (United Kingdom), 'DEU' (Germany), 'FRA' (France), 'JPN' (Japan), 'CHN' (China), 'IND' (India), 'BRA' (Brazil), 'CAN' (Canada), 'AUS' (Australia).

indicator.description: Macroeconomic indicator code to retrieve. Available indicators include: 'gdp_current_usd' (GDP in current USD, default), 'gdp_per_capita_usd' (GDP per capita), 'real_gdp_per_capita' (Real GDP per capita), 'gdp_growth_annual' (Annual GDP growth %), 'inflation_consumer_prices_annual' (Consumer price inflation %), 'unemployment_total_percent' (Unemployment rate %), 'population_total' (Total population), 'life_expectancy' (Life expectancy at birth), 'gni_current_usd' (Gross National Income), 'exports_of_goods_services_percent_gdp' (Exports % of GDP), 'imports_of_goods_services_percent_gdp' (Imports % of GDP), 'real_interest_rate' (Real interest rate %), 'central_government_debt_percent_gdp' (Government debt % of GDP), 'net_migration' (Net migration), and many more.

post.description: Retrieves comprehensive fundamental data for mutual funds via EODHD API. Returns fund details including general information (name, family, inception date, summary), asset allocation (cash, stocks, bonds percentages), value/growth measures (P/E, price-to-book), sector weightings, and world regions exposure. Supports over 20,000 US mutual funds including equity, balanced, and bond-based funds. Use ticker format 'SYMBOL.US' (e.g., 'VFIAX.US', 'SWPPX.US') or ISIN/CUSIP identifiers.

filter.description: Optional filter to retrieve specific sections of the data. Examples: 'General', 'MutualFund', 'MutualFund::Asset_Allocation'. Leave empty to get full fundamental data.

ticker.description: Mutual fund ticker symbol in 'TICKER.EXCHANGE' format. Examples: 'VFIAX.US' (Vanguard 500 Index Fund Admiral), 'SWPPX.US' (Schwab S&P 500 Index Fund). You can also use ISIN/CUSIP identifiers (e.g., 'US8085098551').

post.description: Retrieves real-time (delayed 15-20 minutes for stocks, ~1 minute for forex) OHLCV data for stocks, forex, and cryptocurrencies. Returns latest 1-minute bar with open, high, low, close, volume, previous close, and price changes. Use this when you need current market prices and intraday data.

s.description: Additional ticker symbols comma-separated (max 15-20 recommended). Example: 'TSLA.US,MSFT.US,GOOGL.US'. When provided, returns data for multiple symbols in a single request.

fmt.description: Output format for the API response

symbol.description: Primary ticker symbol with exchange code (e.g., 'AAPL.US' for Apple stock, 'EURUSD.FOREX' for EUR/USD forex pair, 'BTC-USD.CC' for Bitcoin). Format is 'TICKER.EXCHANGE'.

post.description: Retrieve a list of all supported stock exchanges from EODHD API. Returns exchange codes, names, countries, and currencies for 70+ global exchanges. Use this when you need to discover available exchanges or verify exchange codes for ticker symbols.

fmt.description: Output format for the exchanges list response.

post.description: Search for stocks, ETFs, mutual funds, bonds, and indices by ticker symbol, company name, or ISIN. Use when you need to find instruments by name or identifier, discover available tickers, or look up securities across exchanges. The API searches among active tickers only.

type.description: Filter results by instrument type. Available types: 'stock', 'fund', 'etf', 'bond', 'index'. Leave empty to search all types.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. If not specified, API returns all matching results.

query.description: Search query to find instruments by ticker symbol, company name, or ISIN. Examples: 'AAPL' (Apple ticker), 'Apple Inc' (company name), 'US0378331005' (ISIN).

exchange.description: Filter results by exchange code. Examples: 'US' (United States), 'LSE' (London Stock Exchange), 'TO' (Toronto). Leave empty to search all exchanges.

post.description: Get Finnhub's current key ratios and annual or quarterly metric series for one company.

symbol.description: Company ticker whose financial metrics should be returned.

post.description: Look up a company profile by exactly one ticker, ISIN, or CUSIP.

isin.description: Company ISIN. Provide exactly one identifier.

cusip.description: Company CUSIP. Provide exactly one identifier.

symbol.description: Company ticker, such as AAPL. Provide exactly one identifier.

post.description: Check whether an exchange is open now and identify its current session, timezone, or holiday.

exchange.description: Finnhub exchange code, such as US.

post.description: Get the latest price snapshot for one Finnhub symbol. Unknown symbols fail explicitly instead of returning a misleading zero quote.
Get price snapshots for 1-10 Finnhub symbols in one tool call. This uses one Finnhub API request per symbol and reports unrecognized symbols per result.

symbols.description: One to 10 unique Finnhub symbols to quote. The tool makes one upstream request per symbol and preserves this order in the results.

post.description: Retrieve as-reported balance-sheet, cash-flow, and income-statement data for a company or filing. A ticker, CIK, or accession number is required; large statement details are available only when requested.

cik.description: SEC Central Index Key used to find reports. Required when neither a ticker nor an accession number is provided.

symbol.description: Company ticker used to find reports. Required when neither CIK nor an accession number is provided.

to_date.description: Optional report end-date upper bound in YYYY-MM-DD format; provide with from_date.

from_date.description: Optional report end-date lower bound in YYYY-MM-DD format; provide with to_date.

max_reports.description: Maximum reports returned by the tool; Finnhub does not paginate this endpoint.

access_number.description: SEC accession number for one specific report. Required when neither a ticker nor CIK is provided.

include_statement_details.description: Include full balance-sheet, cash-flow, and income-statement arrays. Leave false for compact report metadata because statement bodies can be large.

post.description: List earnings releases or IPO events in an ordered date range. Use an earnings ticker or a narrow date window because Finnhub does not paginate or server-limit these calendars.

symbol.description: Optional earnings ticker filter; unavailable for IPO events.

event_type.description: Calendar dataset to query: earnings releases or IPO events.

max_results.description: Maximum events returned by the tool. This local cap does not reduce Finnhub's upstream payload, so use a ticker or narrow date range.

include_international.description: For earnings only, include international markets.

post.description: List a company's recent actual versus estimated earnings and surprise values.

symbol.description: Company ticker, such as AAPL; must not be blank.

max_results.description: Requested and locally enforced result cap. Finnhub may ignore the upstream limit; the free tier currently returns the last four quarters.

post.description: List SEC filing metadata; a ticker, CIK, or accession number is required, optionally filtered by form and an ordered date range.

cik.description: SEC Central Index Key used to find filings. Required when neither a ticker nor an accession number is provided.

form.description: Optional SEC form filter, such as 10-K or NT 10-K.

symbol.description: Company ticker used to find filings. Required when neither CIK nor an accession number is provided.

to_date.description: Optional filing-date upper bound in YYYY-MM-DD format; provide with from_date.

from_date.description: Optional filing-date lower bound in YYYY-MM-DD format; provide with to_date.

max_results.description: Maximum filings returned by the tool; Finnhub does not paginate this endpoint.

access_number.description: SEC accession number for one specific filing. Required when neither a ticker nor CIK is provided.

post.description: Get broad market news by category or company-specific news for an ordered date range. Use narrow company date ranges because Finnhub does not paginate or server-limit company news.

min_id.description: For market news, return updates after this article ID. Use next_min_id from a prior untruncated response for incremental polling.

symbol.description: Exact company ticker. Required only when news_type is company.

to_date.description: Company-news end date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Required with from_date when news_type is company; unavailable for market news.

category.description: Market-news category. Required only when news_type is market.

from_date.description: Company-news start date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Required with to_date when news_type is company; unavailable for market news.

news_type.description: Use market for category news or company for ticker-specific news.

max_results.description: Maximum articles returned by the tool. This local cap does not reduce Finnhub's company-news payload, so prefer narrow company date ranges.

post.description: Find tradable symbols by ticker, company name, ISIN, or CUSIP, optionally restricted to an exchange.

query.description: Ticker, company name, ISIN, or CUSIP to search; must not be blank.

exchange.description: Optional Finnhub exchange code to restrict matches.

max_results.description: Maximum matches returned by the tool; Finnhub provides no server-side limit.

post.description: Generate original voice previews synchronously from a voice description, without cloning or saving a voice model.

n.description: Number of voice candidates (1–4); the request is billed once.

speed.description: Preview speaking speed multiplier, greater than zero and at most 3.

language.description: Optional BCP-47 language hint, such as en or ja.

instruction.description: Describe the desired original voice; do not impersonate an identifiable person.

reference_text.description: Optional preview text, up to 150 characters.

post.description: Returns place and query predictions for text input. Use when implementing as-you-type autocomplete functionality for place searches. Returns up to five predictions ordered by relevance.

input.description: Text string to search for place predictions. Can be full words, substrings, place names, addresses, or plus codes. Must be non-empty.

regionCode.description: Region code in ccTLD format for formatting responses (e.g., 'us', 'br').

inputOffset.description: Zero-based Unicode character offset of cursor position in the input string.

languageCode.description: Preferred language for results using IETF BCP-47 language codes (e.g., 'en-US', 'es-ES').

center.description: Center point with latitude and longitude coordinates.

radius.description: Radius in meters (0.0-50000.0 for bias, must exceed 0.0 for restriction).

circle.description: Circular area for location bias or restriction.

low.description: Southwest corner with latitude and longitude coordinates.

high.description: Northeast corner with latitude and longitude coordinates.

rectangle.description: Rectangular area for location bias or restriction.

locationBias.description: Area to bias search results toward.

sessionToken.description: User-generated string grouping calls into sessions for billing purposes.

includedRegionCodes.description: Up to 15 two-character country codes (ISO 3166-1 Alpha-2) to restrict results. Query predictions unavailable when this is set.

center.description: Center point with latitude and longitude coordinates.

radius.description: Radius in meters (0.0-50000.0 for bias, must exceed 0.0 for restriction).

circle.description: Circular area for location bias or restriction.

low.description: Southwest corner with latitude and longitude coordinates.

high.description: Northeast corner with latitude and longitude coordinates.

rectangle.description: Rectangular area for location bias or restriction.

locationRestriction.description: Area to restrict search results within.

includedPrimaryTypes.description: Restricts results to up to five specified primary types (e.g., 'restaurant', 'cafe').

includeQueryPredictions.description: Includes query predictions in response for text searches (default: false).

includePureServiceAreaBusinesses.description: Includes businesses without physical locations (default: false).

post.description: Tool to map addresses to geographic coordinates with query parameter. Use when you need to convert a textual address into latitude/longitude coordinates using the modern v4beta API. Results may match multiple places — always verify `formattedAddress`, `region`, and `addressComponents` in the response before using returned coordinates.

region_code.description: Region code, specified as a ccTLD two-character value (e.g., 'US', 'FR'). This parameter affects results based on applicable law.

address_query.description: The unstructured address to geocode. This should be a single string containing the full address (e.g., '1600 Amphitheatre Parkway Mountain View CA'). Include city, state/region, and country where possible — incomplete or ambiguous strings may return zero results or incorrect matches.

language_code.description: Language in which the results should be returned (e.g., 'en', 'es', 'fr').

post.description: Tool to convert geographic coordinates (latitude and longitude) to human-readable addresses using reverse geocoding. Use when you need to find the address or place name for a given set of coordinates. A single coordinate pair may return multiple results; verify formattedAddress, region, and addressComponents before committing to a result.

types.description: Set of type tags to restrict results; results without specified types are removed

regionCode.description: Region code specified as a ccTLD two-character value, affecting results based on applicable law

languageCode.description: Language code in which the results should be returned (BCP-47 format)

post.description: Tool to perform geocode lookup using a place identifier to retrieve address and coordinates. Use when you need to get detailed geographic information for a specific Google Place ID.

place_id.description: Place identifier to geocode. Must be in the format 'places/{placeId}' or just the place ID (e.g., 'ChIJj61dQgK6j4AR4GeTYWZsKWw'). The unique identifier for a place in the Google Places database.

regionCode.description: Region code specified as a ccTLD two-character value, affecting results based on applicable law and address formatting.

languageCode.description: Language code in which the results should be returned (BCP-47 format). Defaults to 'en' if not specified.

post.description: Convert addresses into geographic coordinates (latitude and longitude) and vice versa (reverse geocoding), or get an address for a Place ID. Uses the Geocoding API v4 (v4beta) which supports OAuth2 authentication. Exactly one of `address`, `latlng`, or `place_id` must be provided per request; omitting all three or mixing incompatible combinations yields no useful results.

key.description: Your application's API key. If not provided, will be extracted from connection metadata.

bounds.description: The bounding box of the viewport within which to bias geocode results more prominently (e.g., '34.172684,-118.604794|34.236144,-118.500938'). This parameter will only influence, not fully restrict, results.

latlng.description: The latitude and longitude coordinates specifying the location for which you want the closest, human-readable address (e.g., '40.714224,-73.961452'). Provide for reverse geocoding.

region.description: The region code, specified as a ccTLD ('top-level domain') two-character value. This parameter will only influence, not fully restrict, results from the geocoder.

address.description: The street address or plus code that you want to geocode. Provide for geocoding (address to coordinates).

language.description: The language in which to return results. If language is not supplied, the geocoder attempts to use the preferred language as specified in the Accept-Language header, or the native language of the domain from which the request is sent.

place_id.description: The place ID of the place for which you wish to obtain the human-readable address. Provide for place ID geocoding.

components.description: A components filter with elements separated by a pipe (|). E.g., 'postal_code:94043|country:US'. Used for geocoding, can be restrictive or biasing. Supplying only `components` without `address` may return ZERO_RESULTS for some queries.

result_type.description: A filter of one or more address types, separated by a pipe (|) (e.g., 'street_address|locality'). Used for reverse geocoding and place ID geocoding.

location_type.description: A filter of one or more location types, separated by a pipe (|) (e.g., 'ROOFTOP|RANGE_INTERPOLATED'). Used for reverse geocoding and place ID geocoding.

extra_computations.description: Use this parameter to specify additional features in the response. Can select multiple values.

post.description: Tool to retrieve a 2D map tile image at specified coordinates for building custom map visualizations. Use when you need to download individual map tile images for roadmap, satellite, or terrain views. Requires a valid session token from the createSession endpoint.

y.description: Tile row coordinate. Valid range: [0, (2^(zoom-1))-1]. Valid range: [0, (2^zoom)-1], same as `x`.

z.description: Zoom level ranging from 0 (entire world) to 22 (highly detailed).

key.description: Google API key for authentication. If not provided, will be extracted from connection metadata. Required if not using Bearer token authentication.

session.description: Session token UUID obtained from /v1/createSession endpoint. Valid for approximately two weeks. Required for all 2D tile requests. Reuse across multiple tile requests; each createSession call consumes quota.

orientation.description: Rotation parameter in degrees counter-clockwise. Valid values: 0, 90, 180, or 270.

post.description: Tool to retrieve the 3D Tiles tileset root configuration for photorealistic 3D map rendering. Use when you need to initialize a 3D renderer with Google's photorealistic tiles following the OGC 3D Tiles specification. The Map Tiles API is billable per request; cache the root response client-side and avoid repeated calls.

key.description: Your Google Maps API key with Map Tiles API enabled. If not provided, will be extracted from connection metadata.

post.description: Retrieves time zone information for a specific geographic location and timestamp. Use this action when you need to determine the time zone ID, UTC offset, daylight savings offset, or localized time zone name for any point on Earth. The API considers the provided timestamp to accurately determine whether daylight savings is in effect at that moment.

language.description: Supported language codes for Google Maps API.

location.description: A comma-separated latitude,longitude tuple representing the location to look up. For example: '39.6034810,-119.6822510'.

timestamp.description: The desired time as seconds since midnight, January 1, 1970 UTC (Unix epoch time). The API uses this timestamp to determine whether Daylight Savings should be applied for the location's time zone.

post.description: Tool to perform forward or reverse geocoding. Use when converting between textual addresses and latitude/longitude coordinates.

q.description: Text to geocode (forward geocoding). Required when reverse=false; must be omitted if reverse=true.

key.description: Your GraphHopper API key. If not provided, it will be automatically injected from the connection.

bbox.description: Bounding box 'minLon,minLat,maxLon,maxLat'. Requires reverse=false. Only provider=default.

zoom.description: Map-like zoom level controlling focus radius. Only provider=default.

limit.description: Maximum number of results. Default 5.

point.description: Coordinate 'lat,lon'. Required when reverse=true; for forward geocoding, acts as location bias.

radius.description: Search radius. Default: km for provider=default when reverse=true; meters for provider=gisgraphy.

osm_tag.description: OSM tags to filter/include or exclude, e.g., 'tourism:museum' or '!tourism:museum'. Only provider=default.

reverse.description: Set to true for reverse geocoding. Default false.

countrycode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country filter. For nominatim, gisgraphy, or opencagedata.

autocomplete.description: Enable autocomplete (only for provider=gisgraphy and reverse=false).

location_bias_scale.description: Location bias scale between 0.0 and 1.0. Only provider=default.

post.description: Tool to compute a distance and/or time matrix using GET request with query parameters. Use for simpler matrix requests with query parameters instead of POST body.

point.description: Specify multiple points in 'latitude,longitude' format for which the matrix should be calculated. The starts are identical to the destinations. If there are N points, then NxN entries will be calculated. Specify at least three points. Cannot be used together with from_point or to_point.

profile.description: The routing profile. It determines the network, speed and other physical attributes used when computing the route. Valid values include 'car', 'bike', 'foot', 'hike', 'mtb', 'racingbike', 'scooter', 'truck', and 'small_truck'.

curbside.description: Optional parameter. Specifies on which side a point should be relative to the driver when she leaves/arrives at a start/target/via point. Must be 'any', 'left', or 'right'. Specify for either none or all points.

to_point.description: The destination points for the routes in 'latitude,longitude' format. Use together with from_point for asymmetric matrices.

fail_fast.description: Specifies whether or not the matrix calculation should return with an error as soon as possible in case some points cannot be found or some points are not connected. If set to false, the matrix will be calculated for all valid points and contain null values for entries that could not be calculated.

out_array.description: Specifies which arrays should be included in the response. Specify one or more of 'weights', 'times', 'distances'. The units of distances are meters, times are seconds, and weights are arbitrary.

from_point.description: The origin points for the routes in 'latitude,longitude' format. Use together with to_point for asymmetric matrices.

point_hint.description: Optional parameter. Specifies a hint for each point parameter to prefer a certain street for the closest location lookup.

to_curbside.description: Curbside setting for the to_point parameter. Must be 'any', 'left', or 'right'.

from_curbside.description: Curbside setting for the from_point parameter. Must be 'any', 'left', or 'right'.

to_point_hint.description: For the to_point parameter. Specifies a hint to prefer a certain street for the closest location lookup.

from_point_hint.description: For the from_point parameter. Specifies a hint to prefer a certain street for the closest location lookup.

snap_prevention.description: Optional parameter to prevent snapping to specific types of roads. Supported values: 'motorway', 'trunk', 'ferry', 'tunnel', 'bridge', 'ford'.

post.description: Tool to calculate the best path connecting two or more points using simple GET request. Use when you need basic routing with query parameters.

point.description: Route waypoints as 'latitude,longitude' strings. Specify at least origin and destination. Via points are possible. Example: ['51.131,12.414', '48.224,3.867']

details.description: Path detail types to include. Available: 'street_name', 'street_ref', 'street_destination', 'leg_time', 'leg_distance', 'roundabout', 'country', 'time', 'distance', 'max_speed', 'max_weight', 'max_width', 'toll', 'road_class', 'road_class_link', 'road_access', 'road_environment', 'hazmat', 'hazmat_tunnel', 'hazmat_water', 'lanes', 'surface', 'smoothness', 'hike_rating', 'mtb_rating', 'foot_network', 'bike_network'

heading.description: Preferred heading direction for each point in degrees (0-360, north-based clockwise). Specify one for start or one per point. Requires ch.disable=true.

profile.description: The routing profile determining network, speed, and physical attributes. Common values: 'car', 'bike', 'foot', 'motorcycle', 'mtb', 'racingbike', 'hike'. Default: 'car'

curbside.description: Side of the road for leaving/arriving at each point. Specify for all points or none. Only for motor vehicles.

optimize.description: If 'true', reorders points to minimize total travel time. Applies route optimization limits and increases the price.

algorithm.description: Special routing algorithm. 'round_trip': returns to start with randomness. 'alternative_route': provides multiple route options.

elevation.description: Include altitude as third coordinate in response. Changes format of points and snapped_waypoints fields.

ch.disable.description: Enable flexible mode to use custom_model or advanced options below. Set to true for heading, algorithm, etc.

point_hint.description: Optional road name hints for snapping each point. Specify none or the same number as points.

calc_points.description: Whether to calculate route geometry points.

instructions.description: Whether to calculate and return turn-by-turn instructions.

pass_through.description: Avoid u-turns at via-points with regard to heading_penalty. Requires ch.disable=true.

points_encoded.description: Use polyline encoding for geometry (true) or simple coordinate pairs (false).

heading_penalty.description: Time penalty in seconds for not obeying specified heading. Requires ch.disable=true.

round_trip.seed.description: Random seed for deterministic round trip results. Requires algorithm='round_trip'.

snap_prevention.description: Prevent snapping to specific road types. Values: 'motorway', 'trunk', 'ferry', 'tunnel', 'bridge', 'ford'

round_trip.distance.description: Approximate round trip length in meters. Requires algorithm='round_trip'.

alternative_route.max_paths.description: Maximum number of alternative paths. Requires algorithm='alternative_route'.

alternative_route.max_share_factor.description: Maximum similarity factor between alternative and optimal route. Requires algorithm='alternative_route'.

alternative_route.max_weight_factor.description: Maximum factor by which alternatives can be longer than optimal route. Requires algorithm='alternative_route'.

post.description: Tool to compute isochrone polygons for a given point. Use when you need to determine areas reachable within time or distance constraints.

point.description: Start location as 'latitude,longitude', e.g., '52.529407,13.397634'. Must be a valid coordinate string.

buckets.description: Number of isochrone rings/buckets to return. Divides time_limit/distance_limit into intervals to create nested isochrones. Default is 1.

profile.description: Routing profile supported by the target Directions API, for example 'car', 'bike', or 'foot'. Public transit requires separate GTFS/departure-time inputs that this action does not expose. Required.

time_limit.description: Maximum travel time in seconds from the start point. Either time_limit or distance_limit must be provided. Default is 600 seconds if neither is specified by the API.

reverse_flow.description: Direction of reachability calculation. False (default): areas reachable FROM the point. True: areas FROM which the point can be reached.

distance_limit.description: Maximum travel distance in meters from the start point. Either time_limit or distance_limit must be provided.

post.description: Tool to calculate distance, time, or weight matrices via POST. Use when you have multiple origins/destinations or a symmetric point set and need a single batch request.

points.description: Coordinates for symmetric matrix as [longitude, latitude].

fail_fast.description: If false, return null for unreachable entries and include hints.

to_points.description: Destination coordinates as [longitude, latitude]. Provide with from_points.

from_points.description: Origin coordinates as [longitude, latitude]. Provide with to_points.

point_hints.description: Hint per point for snapping preference (symmetrical).

to_point_hints.description: Hint per destination for snapping preference.

from_point_hints.description: Hint per origin for snapping preference.

snap_preventions.description: Feature types to avoid for snapping (e.g. 'toll', 'ferry').

post.description: Tool to calculate complex routes via POST /route. Use when you need advanced route planning with custom parameters.

points.description: Ordered list of [lon, lat] pairs for route waypoints; at least two points required

headings.description: Preferred headings in degrees; requires ch.disable=true

optimize.description: Reorder points to minimize travel time

ch.disable.description: Enable flexible mode for custom_model and advanced options

seed.description: Random seed for deterministic round trip; requires algorithm='round_trip'

distance.description: Approximate round-trip length in meters; requires algorithm='round_trip'

round_trip.description: Parameters for round trip; requires algorithm='round_trip'

point_hints.description: Optional street hints; one per point

areas.description: GeoJSON FeatureCollection for custom areas; requires ch.disable=true

speed.description: Customize speeds per model rule; requires ch.disable=true

priority.description: Customize priorities per model rule; requires ch.disable=true

distance_influence.description: Influence of distance on custom cost; requires ch.disable=true

pass_through.description: Avoid u-turns at via points; requires ch.disable=true

heading_penalty.description: Penalty (s) for deviating from heading; requires ch.disable=true

snap_preventions.description: Road types to avoid during snapping

max_paths.description: Max number of alternatives; requires algorithm='alternative_route'

max_share_factor.description: Max share factor vs optimal; requires algorithm='alternative_route'
